title: E115: blind pool 3 on the card - the power model M5 (and M4) against 25 tiles written before the model was read (Q133, aifoundry3 card 0, 600 MHz)
request: Q133 (Sun 1 Nov 2026): kinds page section 11 item 6, a power model across kinds
card: aifoundry3 card 0 (no V3_DEVICE), 600 MHz pinned; TDP 0 W / threshold 65 C read, never set

harness.binary: build/sparsity/host/sparsity_host in aifoundry3's ~/aifoundry (26 Sep 06:15), the one E67-E95 ran; no rebuild

plan.order: Random('E115|aifoundry3|<pass>'): the 25 tiles dealt into three segments of 9, 8, 8, each with E78's six anchors, reshuffled; the tie first and last

E115-R1.what: the float family: rms(D - M5) over the priority-1 float tiles, a3 footing
E115-R1.set: type fp32 or fp16, priority 1 (16 tiles if all run)
E115-R1.verdict: PASS if rms <= the interval's upper bound (inside, or below it: then better than the nested score says); FAIL if above
E115-R1.interval: the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of the set's format mix drawn with replacement from M5's nested leave-one-kind-out float errors of that format (both cards), 100,000 draws, seed 11500, recomputed for the tiles that ran
E115-R1.population_source: docs/reports/data/2026-11-01-q133b-power-model/corrections-check.txt C7 (floats); for 283 rows, reported beside, never the verdict

E115-R2.what: the int8 family: rms(D - M5) over the int8 tiles, a3 footing
E115-R2.set: type int8, priorities 1 and 2 (6 tiles if all run)
E115-R2.verdict: PASS if rms <= the interval's upper bound; FAIL if above
E115-R2.interval: as R1, from M5's 78 nested int8 errors

E115-R3.what: coverage: the share of every tile that ran whose D lies inside M5's frozen 95% interval (a3)

E115-R4.what: the contrasts: the share of the seven whose measured value (D(plus) - D(minus) in each kept pass, averaged) lies inside contrasts-blind3.json's M5 a3 interval
E115-R4.else: INCONCLUSIVE; each contrast INSIDE, BELOW or ABOVE

E115-R5.what: M5 against M4 as frozen: rms(D - M4) - rms(D - M5) over the priority-1 float tiles, paired bootstrap over tiles
E115-R5.verdict: M5 BETTER if the 95% interval is above 0; M4 BETTER if below; else UNRESOLVED

E115-S1.what: the session tie against E78 (E95's bands); reported, never a verdict on the model

reported: per format (fp32, fp16 priority 1 and all; int8): rms and bias of M5, M4 and F0r
per open case: n, mean D - M5 with its 95% interval over tiles, rms of M5 and M4, how many inside
the per-format term: M5 against F0r (paired bootstrap over the priority-1 float tiles), and the refit: F0r against M4; on the fp16 tiles apart
int8: M5 (I3 refitted) against M4 (I3 as frozen)
R1 without the flagged tile (fp16.s_wpair0), R1 against the a3-only interval and against the 283-row population interval
every tile: D with its 95% interval over passes, M5 [95%], D - M5, M4, D - M4, F0r
the anchor footing; the leak, dips and gates arms

expected.E115-R1: PASS, near 0.27 W, the largest misses on the fp32 sign tiles and fp32.x_logu_s50, reading above M5 (as E103's c_near_rand, s_bhalf_alt and x_e_g did)
expected.E115-R4: PASS or INCONCLUSIVE; s_bridge - s_pair0 the likeliest outside
expected.E115-R5: UNRESOLVED (the two models differ by at most 0.20 W on any tile)
expected.memory path: INSIDE: no memory-path term at +-0.56 W
